payout_quote: Existing member: Cash reward of $50 will be deposited to referring member's savings account within 10 business days after the referred membership has met all checking account requirements or after the referred loan has funded.
steps: Be an existing BFG FCU member serving Summit County, Ohio (or immediate family/household of someone who does).
Refer a new member: they enter promo code RR2021 plus your name and email when applying online, or present the Referral Rewards Coupon in person.

The new member opens a new checking account with a monthly direct deposit of $400+ that remains open for at least 60 days, OR obtains a new loan with a minimum balance of $5,000, within the first 60 days after account opening.
You receive a $50 cash reward deposited to your savings account within 10 business days of all qualifications being met (the new member also gets $50).
catches: The friend's requirements are real: $400/month direct deposit for 60 days minimum, or a new $5,000+ loan - this is a heavier bar than most CU referral programs.
New members must submit the Referral Rewards Coupon (or use promo code RR2021 online); missing the code means no bonus.
18+; business, custodial, and minor accounts don't qualify; excludes existing loans refinanced through BFG.
Offer can be cancelled, withdrawn, or changed at any time without notice.
Cash reward may be reported as income on a 1099-INT.
biggest_catch: Your friend needs a genuine $400/month direct deposit running for 60 days (or a $5,000+ loan) - a casual account open won't trigger the $50.
eligibility: Existing BFG FCU members 18+; referred persons must be new members eligible for BFG FCU membership (Summit County, Ohio field of membership) 18+.
timing: Cash reward deposited within 10 business days after all qualifications are met.
